node.title: PMA rate-half source cross-ratio fiber reduction
node.statement: Affine changes of the three source labels preserve the tail list, so every distinct triple normalizes to (0,1,lambda). Modulo the core RS code the source quotient code is two-dimensional. The lambda coefficient of the source numerator factors as L_1L_2R_3 with deg R_3<ell, leaving at most ell-1 exceptional core points. Removing their maximum overlap weight from the aligned gcd bonus leaves at least 2b+3a-2 weighted nonexceptional incidences voting for one source cross-ratio lambda. Absence of this fiber certificate pays the tail by 8n per source.
